notes: MuseMaxxingToken (src/MuseMaxxingToken.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin Contracts v5.1.0 ERC20: name MuseMaxxing, symbol MAXX, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 MAXX (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on this launch is the ProjectFactory; the factory then pays the supply out (swarm share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 80% seeding the Uniswap v4 pool, the remainder to economics.remainderTo). Nothing can mint afterwards: there is no owner, minter role, pause, blocklist, fee or burn on transfer, upgrade path, receive or fallback, and the runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. Every transfer and transferFrom moves exactly the amount requested, so the launch flows arrive whole without any exemptions. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply.
